text:
Marta: Quick sync: propose we prioritize an MVP that reduces customer surprise during model swaps by adding: 1) adaptive sampling (cost-aware), 2) a documented "gracepath" billing flow, 3) curated rollback runbooks. Anyone object?

Diego: Love it. Adaptive sampling = our unique angle. Instead of fixed samples, sample until CI width < threshold or max N. That saves cost for stable models. Suggest defaults: min 50, max 500, CI target 95% with width <= 1.5%.

Zara: Eval caveats: different tasks need different proxies. We should allow per-model "eval profile" (semantic similarity for embeddings, ROUGE-lite for summarization). But default profile for onboarding is a conservative text-overlap + model-agnostic embed-sim. Document that clearly.

Marta: Nice. That implies two UX pieces: a simple "sampling budget" slider and an advanced section for eval profile selection. Default to budget=150 and adaptive mode ON.

Omar: Routing/ops: adaptive sampling can run in stages: quick CI-run during upload (cheap) and an optional live mirror sample (1% traffic) for higher fidelity. Mirror should be capped and have auto-pause rules. Also add header `x-rw-sample-run` with run-id.

Diego: Implementation sketch: sampling service that accepts model_id + eval_profile + seed + budget cap; returns {n_samples, delta_mean, delta_ci, runtime_ms}. We'll expose endpoint `/v1/models/{id}/sample-estimate`. Keep it lightweight: run on batch workers with quantized inputs to reduce cost.

Zara: For quality thresholds, propose tiered badges: PASS (delta CI includes 0 and n>=min), REVIEW (delta positive but <2%), FAIL (>2% regression). Show sample-size and CI in the UI. Also expose raw sample ids for reproducibility.

Marta: Gracepath: CS asked for a billing promise during cutovers. MVP: manual voucher issuance up to 14 days. Longer term: automate based on mirror delta and traffic. For MVP we need console copy and a support flow: "Enable 14d gracepath (manual voucher)".

Omar: Ops alerts: pause mirror if mirror_latency_p99 > 2x baseline or mirror_error_rate > 0.5%. Also add an automatic fallback to previous pinned version if FAIL. We'll log the decision.

Diego: Cost note: adaptive sampling reduces median cost by ~60% on stable models vs fixed 300-sample runs. Need to show customers an estimate pre-run: `Estimated runs: 60-240 samples (~$X-$Y)` with a confidence band. We'll build the estimate endpoint first.

Zara: Evals will need metadata. Required fields on ingest: `tokenizer_id`, `avg_seq_len`, `task_hint` (gen/emb/summarize), and optional `gold_sample_url` if the tenant provides reference evals. If missing, sampling falls back to public corpora.

Marta: Rollback runbook: single-console CTA to pause migration + automated note to CS with suggested next steps (increase sample budget, manual review, or rollback). Include email template and recommended SLA language. CS wants this in docs and in the support playbook.

CSBot: Created ticket https://redwood.internal/support/GRACE-901 "gracepath voucher + sampling estimate" assigned to Omar, due 2025-02-15

Marta: Timeline proposal: Sprint 1: sampling service + estimate endpoint + metadata validation (Diego/Zara). Sprint 2: console UI (badge, slider), mirror infra + auto-pause (Omar). Sprint 3: playbook + manual voucher flow + docs (Marta/CS). Owners ok?

Diego: I'm in. I'll prototype the estimate endpoint and a cheap quantized runner. Will post perf numbers mid-week.

Zara: I'll add the eval profiles and default heuristics. I'll also prepare guidance for per-task proxies.

Omar: I'll scope mirror caps and alerts, and add the revert API.

Marta: Decision: ship adaptive sampling + estimate endpoint + metadata validation + minimal console badge + manual 14d gracepath for MVP. Defer automated vouchers and per-tenant profile tuning post-MVP. Reconvene Wed 10am to review PRs. Thanks :thumbsup:
